task_text: Cup catch, route pour, rebound recatch and cart delivery: An orange ball is thrown upward at the start and comes back down near the robot. Catch it in the open cup the Panda holds, pour it into the designated one of two raised gravity channels, let it roll down that channel by itself, drop off its end and bounce off the tilted rebound plate below it, catch it in the cup again while it flies, and finally put it into a cart that slides back and forth on a rail, where it must rest while the cart is still moving. Phases, in order: incoming_catch: the ball, after at least 25 ms of free flight (touching nothing), passes downward through the plane 0.046 m above the cup floor (`tool_height` + radius, one radius above the rim) while its centre is within 0.052 m (`tool_half` - radius) of the cup centre in both tool-frame x and y; after that entry it must stay retained in the cup for 0.18 s without interruption. Retained means: in the cup's frame the ball's centre is within 0.0619 m of the centre in x and y (`tool_half` - 0.45 x radius) and between 0.014 m and 0.0258 m above the floor (radius - 4 mm to `tool_height` - 0.12 x radius), the ball touched the cup within the last 25 ms, and it moves at less than 0.09 m/s relative to the cup.; selected_route_entry: the ball touches the designated channel (route 0, the channel nearer the robot's base, or route 1, the farther one, drawn per instance and given under Goal geometry; the channel trough and its supports count, the separate end stop does not) while its centre is at world y > 0.10 m and it is not touching the cup. Touching the other channel at any time during this phase fails the task (wrong_route).; track_and_rebound: without the ball touching the cup or the table (either fails the task), it touches the rebound plate of the designated route while its centre is at world y < -0.12 m and z > `rebound_height` - 0.005 = 0.255 m.; downstream_catch: the ball is caught in the cup again with the same test as the first catch: at least 25 ms of free flight (counted within this phase), a downward pass through the plane 0.046 m above the cup floor while within 0.052 m of the cup centre in tool-frame x and y, then retained in the cup (same retention conditions) for 0.18 s without interruption.; moving_cart_delivery: the ball rests in the cart: in the cart's frame its centre is within 0.0669 m of the cart centre in x and y (0.075 - 0.45 x radius) and between 0.014 m and 0.0578 m above the cart floor (radius - 4 mm to 0.06 - 0.12 x radius), it touched the cart within the last 25 ms, and it moves at less than 0.09 m/s relative to the cart; it does not touch the cup; and the cart moves along its rail at more than 0.02 m/s; all for 0.7 s without interruption. This completes the task. Goal geometry: At this instance the designated route is route 1: of the two parallel channels, the one farther from the robot's base (the +x one). Touching the other channel during selected_route_entry fails the task (`wrong_route`). Route-entry line: ball centre at world y > 0.10 m (selected_route_entry). Rebound check: ball centre at world y < -0.12 m and z > 0.255 m (track_and_rebound).
episode: one episode, no reset: it ends at the first control step where the task has succeeded (every phase in order) or failed (a failure event, a forbidden contact, a safety-limit violation, an object out of bounds, or the task's horizon of 25 s of simulated time, 2500 control steps), when your time is up, or on a simulator error; the simulated clock advances only with the control steps you run
